duration.text: The Environment Engineering at Dalian University of Technology is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3402 USD/per year ￥ 24500 CNY/per year

materials.text: Certificate of HSK (No need for English taught programs) Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant Postgraduate school transcript Master's degree diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Letter of recommendation From professor or associate professor or equivalents

requirements.text: 1. Hold a master's degree 2. Be in good health 3. Under the age of 45 4. Recommendation of two professors (full or associate) 5. Pass entrance examination. 6. A Chinese level of HSK 5 or above, there are no HSK requirements for those who applied for courses taught in English.
